title: Donald Trump suggests Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO
excerpt: President Donald Trump is suggesting former Apple CEO Tim Cook take over Nvidia following Jensen Huang's resignation.
body_html:
Jensen Huang has stepped down from his role as CEO of Nvidia. His resignation follows reports involving affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.

In the wake of his departure, the company's chief financial officer has taken over leadership on an interim basis. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump has publicly shared his recommendation for the permanent position, stating that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should run the chipmaking giant.
